description: §66.3 rule 10 positive twin of unproven-annotation-neg: `:int` over a call with a DECLARED return (`mk() -> int`) and over a call with an inferred-and-proven return (`six()` returns a literal) is not E-DECL-TYPE-UNPROVEN; the values render (5 7).
rationale: §66.3 rule 10 fires only when the initializer's value is "a call of a function whose return is neither declared nor inferred-and-proven (rule 5)"; rule 5 (g): a return is inferred-and-proven when every `return` carries a member of the set. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package".
